items.title: What's New in ArcGIS Field Maps: November 2026 Update
items.summary: ArcGIS Field Maps is Esri’s premier all-in-one mobile app that combines map viewing, high-accuracy GPS data collection, form-driven inspections, task coordination, and location sharing into a single app that is deeply integrated with the ArcGIS system.

items.title: Building strong safety evaluations
items.summary: Safety evaluations inform some of the most consequential decisions we make about an AI model, including whether it’s ready to deploy, which safeguards ship alongside it, and what our next round of safety training and research should focus on.

items.title: Introducing ChatGPT Wallet

items.title: Two Architects of Key State AI Laws Come to Washington to Do It Again

items.title: New York launches RAISE portal, big AI developers must register by Jan 1
items.summary: In Albany on November 10, Gov. Kathy Hochul opened the RAISE Portal, the online platform where large frontier AI developers must register by January 1, 2027, the day the RAISE Act takes effect.
